institution: Cheltenham High School, Cheltenham Township, Pennsylvania (United States)
detail: His family lived in the Philadelphia area in 1956–1958 and 1963–1967 while his father, historian Benzion Netanyahu, taught at Dropsie College; he graduated in 1967 and returned to Israel to enlist.
Studied architecture at MIT from late 1972, interrupted by service in the 1973 Yom Kippur War, and graduated in February 1975 under the name Ben Nitay.
Completed a master's degree at the MIT Sloan School of Management in 1976.

institution: Massachusetts Institute of Technology; courses at Harvard University
detail: Began doctoral studies in political science alongside his master's degree; they were broken off after the death of his brother Yonatan in the Entebbe raid in July 1976.
